exposure: Care Quality Commission (CQC) inspection-informed ratings of individual maternity units
outcome: Non-spontaneous birth (caesarean birth before labour or induction of labour)
cohort: The study included 501,719 women in the English NHS who had singleton pregnancies and gave birth at term between April 2018 and March 2019.
finding: There was no association between regulatory ratings of maternity units published by the national healthcare regulator and clinical outcomes (severe maternal and neonatal morbidity) or practice measures (non-spontaneous birth and intrapartum caesarean birth).
mod_finding: There was no variation in the rates of non-spontaneous birth (including caesarean birth before labour or induction of labour) or intrapartum caesarean birth across different CQC maternity unit ratings.
cross-section timing: Births occurring between April 2018 and March 2019
